items.description: Jam Gadang is a historic clock tower and major landmark in the city of Bukittinggi, West Sumatra. It was built in 1926 as a gift from the Dutch Queen to the city's controller.
The Kraton Sumenep is the former royal palace of the Sultanate of Sumenep, located on Madura Island. It was designed by a Chinese architect in the 18th century, blending local and foreign styles.
